gloss: to grind; to mash; to crush by rubbing

definitions.explanation: To crush something into a paste or powder by rubbing or grinding.

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}でた{芋|いも}をすり{潰|つぶ}してマッシュポテトを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I mashed the boiled potatoes to make mashed potatoes.

examples.japanese: すり{鉢|ばち}で{味噌|みそ}をすり{潰|つぶ}してから{出汁|だし}に{溶|と}かす。
examples.english: Grind the miso in a mortar and then dissolve it in the broth.

notes:
CONSTRUCTION:
Compound verb from すり (rubbing, from {擦|す}る/{磨|す}る) + {潰|つぶ}す (to crush). Describes crushing by grinding or rubbing action.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes を for the object being ground.

TOOLS:
・すり{鉢|ばち} - mortar (Japanese style)
・すりこぎ - pestle
・フードプロセッサー - food processor

COMMON IN COOKING:
・{胡麻|ごま}をすり{潰|つぶ}す - to grind sesame
・{豆|まめ}をすり{潰|つぶ}す - to mash beans
・{薬味|やくみ}をすり{潰|つぶ}す - to grind condiments
